sections.title: Habits vs. Ongoing Actions
sections.content:
Choose between the two tenses based on time frame:
- **Presente Simple**: Habitual actions, routines, and permanent facts (*Leo el periódico todos los días*).
- **Presente Continuo**: Actions happening at this exact moment (*Ahora mismo estoy leyendo un libro*).

items.spanish: Normalmente tomo café, pero hoy estoy tomando té.
items.english: Normally I drink coffee, but today I am drinking tea.

items.spanish: Carlos trabaja en una empresa, pero hoy está descansando.
items.english: Carlos works at a company, but today he is resting.

items.spanish: ¿Qué haces los sábados? Normalmente salgo con amigos.
items.english: What do you do on Saturdays? Normally I go out with friends.
What are you doing now? I am cooking.

sections.content: Notice the difference in questions: *¿Qué haces?* can mean *What do you do (for a living)?*, whereas *¿Qué estás haciendo?* specifically means *What are you doing right at this second?*
